data.one_liner: Widgets to enable hover effects on Flutter web.
data.what_it_does: Provides ready-to-use widgets like HoverWidget, HoverContainer, HoverCrossFadeWidget, HoverAnimatedContainer, and HoverButton to easily apply hover effects, animations, and transitions on Flutter web.
use_when: You are building a Flutter web application and want to add custom hover effects to containers, buttons, or widgets.
You want simple widget transitions or animated containers triggered by mouse hover without manual MouseRegion boilerplate.
avoid_when: You are targeting exclusively mobile platforms where hover states do not naturally occur.
You need complex physics-based animations or Rive/Lottie vector graphics.
strengths: Provides multiple specialized widgets for common hover scenarios (containers, cross-fade, buttons).
Easy to integrate with existing widget hierarchies.
weaknesses: Limited to web and desktop platforms supporting mouse pointer events.
Only a handful of widget options available.
data.minimal_example:
HoverContainer(
  width: 100,
  height: 100,
  color: Colors.red,
  hoverColor: Colors.green,
  child: Text('Hover me'),
)
